a Han-dynasty Chinese men's zhiju shenyi: a one-piece robe to the ankle in warm brown silk with a cross collar, wide sleeves narrowing at the cuffs, the front overlap falling straight and vertical down the side of the body (no spiral wrap), wide black borders on the collar, cuffs, front edge and hem, and a sash belt
